integrity: The proof starts from the published half-difference zonotope definition. It identifies chord-direction classes exactly by the residue of i+j modulo n, evaluates their total generator lengths by finite trigonometric sums, derives the even-parity support numbers from adjacent edge geometry, and obtains cyclicity, perimeter, area, and full symmetry order without relying on finite computation. The packaged verifier independently reconstructs the zonotope from raw generators.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical centered sweep-polytope normalization of the unit-circumradius regular planar n-gon. It does not classify arbitrary cyclic or affinely regular inputs or higher-dimensional regular configurations. An older shellotope treatment under different terminology remains a residual historical indexing risk because only abstract-level material from that source was inspected.
title: Regular-polygon sweep polytopes are regular exactly in odd order
